AI is getting more powerful by the day.
From AI agents breaking into systems they were never supposed to access to experts warning about the possibility of losing control over AI altogether, some of these risks are no longer just hypothetical.
And yet, we're still not having enough conversations about what happens when things go wrong, who's responsible, and what we can do about it. In this video, we explore the possibilities of what could go wrong with AI and what we need to do to address the dangers this technology poses.
